text_block_list.text:
Huh... I actually won? No way... I won
the Satsuki
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
People said that it couldn't be done, yet
I
somehow managed to pull it off...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Um, Тренер? What kind of magic spell
did you
cast on me?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I just did everything I could.

text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever it is you did, it helped
me run a
great race despite my health
issues.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy! Can I pat your head as a
reward?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Coddling you at the Classics is all I've
been
dreaming of! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You were so impressive that I can't see
you as just
"cute" anymore.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Calling you a good trainer doesn't seem

appropriate for an achievement this
grand. Can I
praise you in a different
way?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Okay, here I go... Nice and loud!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Who's an amazing Тренер?! You're an
amazing
trainer! Yes, you are! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
She praises me with the incredibly rare
"amazing
trainer" compliment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик miraculously conquers the
Satsuki
Sho! Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
